rules: A refusal happens before any provider side effect and creates nothing.
The stable code travels in a separate field (proposed: error.refusal); error.code stays the ADR 0013 name. Adding that field to contracts/cli/output.schema.json is an owner gate.
Codes are never reused or renamed; a new code is appended.

refusals.when: the provider does not support the requested trust profile
a required kernel isolation (including microvm) is not enforced by the provider; no fallback
a required egress policy is not enforced
credential mediation is required and not enforced
a host tool or gateway is required and not provided
the provider cannot deliver the git configuration profile of the requested profile
a writable single-file git configuration mount is planned
the host global git configuration would be planned for any profile other than developer, including the workspace container of ADR 0009
an untrusted_job would get a worktree, alternates or a shared object store
the host Docker socket or another host control socket would be mounted
an /opt/bdock/<bundle> or bundledock-* volume would be writable
a cooperative_job lacks the explicit shared-metadata acknowledgement
a secret-pattern path is included without explicit naming and confirmation
a requested submodule has uncommitted changes
a target container, volume or directory lacks the ownership labels
an operation targets the workspace's primary environment
discard would delete results not exported to an explicit destination
the operation is not allowed in the instance's current state
a developer sandbox request carries a GIT_CONFIG_* variable
a job profile is requested from a provider whose cancellation_cleanup is below force_only
git configuration preflight failed; the instance is not ready
